title: Self-recursive Script
description: Error-prone rule — scripts that call themselves. Recursion can be intentional, but without a solid exit condition it risks a stack overflow.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Self-recursion without a guaranteed base case can exhaust the call stack.
rule.remediation: Confirm a reliable exit condition, or rewrite as a loop.
